description: This file contains utility functions for retrieving chat messages from a database, including handling feedback and session-based pagination, using TypeORM and custom filtering logic.

methods.name: utilGetChatMessage
methods.description: Main function to retrieve chat messages with optional filtering, sorting, pagination, and feedback handling.

methods.name: handleFeedbackQuery
methods.description: Handles retrieval of feedback-related chat messages, including session-based pagination.

methods.name: getMessagesWithFeedback
methods.description: Fetches chat messages with optional feedback filtering and session grouping.

methods.name: filterMessagesWithFeedback
methods.description: Filters messages to include only those with specified feedback types, including previous messages in sessions.
